messages:
Maya (CS): Incoming vendor risk form from BlueHaven Health. They want: confirmation of PII presence in embeddings, exact storage locations, per-tenant retention & deletion workflow, and auditable key provenance. Deadline Tue EOD.
Drew (Security): Can you paste the relevant questions? we'll map to controls and pick non-sensitive artifacts.
Maya (CS): Excerpt they sent: "A) Do embeddings contain or allow reconstruction of PII? B) Where are embeddings stored (bucket/object prefixes)? C) Retention and deletion orchestration per tenant. D) KMS origin, rotation cadence, and access controls."
Nia (Legal): We should pair any technical artifacts with a short legal caveat. No raw customer data. Offer redacted samples and a statement of limitations about reverse reconstruction.
Rafael (Onboarding): I can fetch the embeddings config and the deletion workflow runbook. Which repo again holds the orchestrator playbooks?
Drew (Security): infra-ops/playbooks. Look at /playbooks/tenant-deletion/README.md for the workflow and /configs/embeddings.yml for storage paths. Also see security-docs/kms-audit.md for provenance notes.
Maya (CS): Good. BlueHaven also asked for a sample deletion trace showing a tenant wipe. We can provide a sanitized run from the staging account with timestamps redacted.
Nia (Legal): Make sure the sanitized run removes any tenant identifiers and includes a statement: "This sample is sanitized; real run IDs and PII removed."
Rafael (Onboarding): I'll generate a sanitized run log using the redaction script I keep in /scripts/redact.sh. Command I use: `./redact.sh --file deletion.log --mask-tenant --mask-uuids`
Drew (Security): For the PII-in-embeddings question: we shouldn't assert impossibility. Provide: 1) our engineering note on tokenization & embedding hashing, 2) our mitigation list (rate limits, per-tenant KV cache isolation, no cross-tenant prefix cache hits), and 3) pointer to the eval that attempted reconstruction on synthetic datasets.
Maya (CS): Let's assemble an evidence packet. Proposed items: ``
- sanitized_deletion_run.log (staging)
- redacted_embeddings_paths.yml
- retention_policy_table.pdf (per-data-class)
- KMS_provenance_statement.txt + sample CloudTrail event (redacted)
- security_control_mapping_SOC2.xlsx (highlighted rows)
- mitigation_summary_for_embeddings.md
``
Nia (Legal): Also include a short cover email template explaining redactions and linking the legal caveat. I'll approve the wording.
Rafael (Onboarding): Uploading artifacts to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/bluehaven-evidence (folder created). Files: sanitized_deletion_run.log, paths_redacted.yml, retention_policy_table.pdf, kms_provenance.txt, control_map_SOC2.xlsx, mitigation_summary.md.
evidence-bot: Zendesk ticket CS-4783 opened and linked to BlueHaven (priority: medium-high).
Maya (CS): Timeline: Rafael to finish uploads + redact script tomorrow morning. Drew & Nia to review content by 3pm. I will send the response to BlueHaven with the packet and cover note by 4:30pm. Please flag any blockers here.
Drew (Security): I'll add a short appendix that shows our BYOK options and which customers have BYOK enabled (summary only, no identifiers).
Nia (Legal): I'll run the cover note and the mitigation wording for accuracy; will avoid categorical claims about irreversibility.
Maya (CS): Thanks everyone. If BlueHaven pushes for raw samples, we'll route to an MSA amendment discussion. Leaving this thread open for sign-offs.
